dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: Dadda, will that man come back?

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: Dadda... Is that Fatooey man really a very, very bad person?

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: He told me stowies, and he got me lots of food, too...

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: I don't think that's how bad people are...

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Lily... Bad people and good people aren't that easy to tell apart.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: This is... It's complicated. You'll understand when you're older.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Mommy is a sister, she believes in Barbatos, and she helps and guides all the other people who believe in Barbatos, too.

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: Daddy, who's Papa Toes? Is he a magic man?

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Barbatos is the God of the Wind. He's a very magical man.

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: The reason why Mommy and Daddy and Lily have such a happy life is because Lord Barbatos is a very nice man and looks after us.

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: But Daddy, why is that man over there saying nasty things about Papa Toes?

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Little boys and girls aren't allowed to listen to what the Fatui men say, alright dear?
